description_en: Queries purchasable resources in multiple zones by calling DescribeMultiZoneAvailableResource
description_zh: 通过DescribeMultiZoneAvailableResource获取多可用区可购买的资源
kebab_example: aliyun hbase describe-multi-zone-available-resource --charge-type Prepaid --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-combination cn-hangzhou-bef-aliyun --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMultiZoneAvailableResource

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型：
Prepaid：预付费。
Postpaid：后付费
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The zone combination. If this parameter is not specified, all zone combinations in the region are queried
parameters.help_zh: 可选值，不填时查询该region下全部的组合
parameters.name: zone_combination
